properties.note: A THIRD measured retrieval failure for that open question, and the first where the ranked hit was the query's semantic OPPOSITE rather than merely wrong. Its two recorded cases were a miss (set_interface_designation for a coupling question) and a confidently-wrong hit that causes a defect (contain_component for 'move a component'). This one: 'record when a point in time actually happened' returned plan_epoch, which creates a point that has NOT happened, because the description contains the negation of the query term — and the right tool, add_epoch, was absent from the top five of 180.
